_comment: Port life: what a visiting captain can do at a happening (chain_only: started from the port screen's Town tab, see data/port_life.json), and arrival events that grow out of how the town is (town.* keys) and how it sees you.

life_festival.title: {port} makes merry
life_festival.text: Fireworks over the harbour, a procession with a saint (or a bull, or a giant made of straw), and a crowd that will cheer anyone who gives it a show.

choices.result: Three shots, three oranges off the post. The crowd carries you round the square.
choices.fail_result: You miss the post entirely. Your entry fee buys the winner a drink.

choices.text: Give the crew a night ashore
choices.result: They come back at dawn, broke, hoarse and happy.

choices.text: Pay for a feast for the whole town
choices.result: Roast pigs on every corner, and your name on every tongue.

life_fair.title: The fair
life_fair.text: Bales of Rouen linen and Seville wine stacked to the eaves, mule trains from the mines, bankers changing silver at the church door, and more sharpers than honest men.

choices.result: You beat a Sevillan factor down to a price he'll regret.
choices.fail_result: The factor smiles all the way through. You've paid full price.

choices.text: Buy the moneylenders a dinner and listen
choices.result: Somebody important owes somebody else a great deal, and you know who.

choices.text: Sign on seamen paid off from the fleet
choices.result: Deep-water men, used to long voyages.

choices.text: Keep your purse in your shirt and go back aboard

life_bread_riot.title: Bread riots
life_bread_riot.text: The market square is a mob: women waving empty baskets, men with cudgels, militia with bayonets fixed and no idea what to do. Your hold has food in it, and everyone knows ships carry food.

choices.text: Sell your provisions at a fair price
choices.result: They queue at your boat all afternoon. An old woman kisses your hand.

choices.text: Sell them at what hunger will pay
choices.result: A fortune for salt pork. They'll remember your face, and not fondly.

choices.text: Help the militia clear the square
choices.result: A volley over their heads, and your men with cudgels. The square empties.
choices.fail_result: A flying cobblestone finds your head before the square is clear.

choices.text: Sign on hungry men for their keep
choices.result: They'd sail to hell for three meals a day.

life_ball.title: The governor's ball
life_ball.text: Candles by the hundred, a string band sawing at a minuet, and {gov} receiving guests at the top of the stairs. A planter's wife looks you up and down; two merchants stop talking when you pass.

choices.result: {gov} laughs at your stories and asks you to call again. A favour freely given is a favour owed.
choices.fail_result: You tread on the feet of {gov}'s partner in the minuet. Twice.

choices.result: Planters play deep and badly. You leave with their sugar money.
choices.fail_result: Planters play deep and well, it turns out.

choices.text: Slip away and listen at the study door
choices.result: Letters on the desk that {gov} would not want read aloud.
choices.fail_result: A footman finds you with your ear to the keyhole.

choices.result: Contacts, introductions, and an idea of who's buying.

life_hanging.title: Hanging day
life_hanging.text: Three on the cart, hands tied, one still defiant. The crowd jeers; a parson reads; the hangman tests his ropes. Your crew are watching you as much as the gallows.

choices.result: It takes a long time. The men are quiet that night.

choices.text: Bribe the hangman for one life
choices.result: The rope 'breaks'. By the custom of the place, whoever the rope won't hang goes free, and {condemned} goes free into your crew.

choices.text: Cut {condemned} down tonight, from the gibbet
choices.result: One guard runs, one is persuaded. The Brethren will sing of it.
choices.fail_result: The guard raises the alarm. You lose two hands getting back to the boats.

life_captains_table.title: A captain's table
life_captains_table.text: {cap} has the best table in the tavern, a bottle of good Madeira, and half their crew around them. They look up as you come in.

choices.text: Buy a round and talk shop
choices.result: By the third bottle you're old friends, and you know every weak timber in their ship.
choices.fail_result: A joke lands badly. Knives aren't drawn, quite.

choices.text: Ask what they've seen on the sea lanes
choices.result: They let slip an anchorage that isn't on your chart.
You take their money, and they take it hard.
choices.fail_result: They take your money, and laugh about it.

choices.result: Tables go over. Now everyone knows there's bad blood between you.

town_beggars.title: Beggars on the quay
town_beggars.text: {port} has fallen on hard times. Beggars line the quay: sailors with no ship, a widow with three children, a soldier with one leg.

choices.result: Blessings follow you up the quay.
Three of them are aboard before you've finished speaking.

town_patron.title: A rich man's errand
town_patron.text: Business is booming in {port}, and a merchant with more money than time wants a dependable captain to carry letters of credit to his partners. Word is you can be trusted.

choices.result: Easy money, and a friend in the counting house.

town_curfew.title: Curfew
town_curfew.text: {port} is close to revolt. The militia has proclaimed a curfew: any sailor in the streets after dark goes to the stocks.

choices.text: Keep the crew aboard after dark
choices.result: A long dull evening of watching the town's lights.
One ends up in the stocks and isn't let out before you sail.

town_welcome.title: A welcome
town_welcome.text: Word of your coming has reached {port} ahead of you. People wave from the quay; a boy runs to tell the tavern keeper; the harbour master raises a hat.

choices.text: Doff your hat to the crowd
choices.result: The crew walk a little taller ashore.

town_ballads.title: Ballads
town_ballads.text: Children in {port} are singing a ballad about you: your cruelty, your gold, and how you'll hang one day. Their mothers drag them indoors as you pass.

choices.text: Toss them a coin for the next verse
choices.result: The next verse is worse. The crew love it.
They scatter.

town_war_widows.title: The widows' fund
town_war_widows.text: The war has filled {port}'s churchyard with sailors who never came home. The parish is collecting for their widows, and the churchwarden has an eye on you.

choices.result: Your name goes in the parish book.
A nod from the churchwarden.
